⭐ 1 Star (If there were an option for minus stars, I would have chosen that.)
Extremely pathetic and disappointing experience.
I rarely write negative reviews, but the experience at this lab was so poor that I feel other patients should be aware of it.

A diagnostic lab is a place where people come with health concerns, stress, and anxiety. The least they deserve is respectful treatment. This lab seriously needs to improve its staff training, patient handling, and overall professionalism.

Not recommended at all 👎
